device_entry.name: Julabo 温度循环控制器
device_entry.description: JULABO 温度循环控制设备是一类实验室台式液体温控装置，包括加热循环器、制冷/加热循环器、低温紧凑型循环器和再循环冷却器。它通过循环传热液体为外部设备或样品提供稳定的加热、制冷或恒温控制，常用于反应釜、冷凝器、分析仪器和其他需要精确温度管理的实验系统。
device_entry.description_en: JULABO temperature circulation equipment is a family of benchtop liquid temperature control devices, including heating circulators, refrigerated/heating circulators, cryo-compact circulators, and recirculating coolers. They circulate a heat-transfer fluid to provide stable heating, cooling, or constant-temperature control for external equipment or samples, commonly used with reactors, condensers, analytical instruments, and other laboratory systems requiring precise temperature management.
